name: astral-orchestrator
description: Beginner-friendly orchestration with Quick, Guided, Careful, and explicit opt-in Measured modes for planning, delegating, verifying, and reviewing project work in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, risk-aware delivery for any project.
interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator offers Quick, Guided, Careful, and explicit opt-in Measured modes: Quick keeps tiny work in Sol with self-review; Guided, Careful, and Measured route bounded work to pinned Luna or Terra lanes at their configured efforts, verify changes, and request a fresh Sol reviewer. Measured records local evidence and never runs automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral Orchestrator in Guided mode (the default) to complete this request and verify the result.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Measured mode for this evidence-oriented request.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Careful mode for this risky change.
